ABOUT

THE ARCHITECT

Brandon Montford is a 21-year-old mobile engineer from Atlanta, GA. Recent graduate of Concordia University Chicago with a dual Bachelor's in Computer Science and Communications. Dean's List, Best Capstone Award, top 10 nationally in IEEE competition, and inaugural Honor Council member.

Former Division III student-athlete in football and track. That discipline carried into building: an AAC app for his brother with Down syndrome, a B2B fitness platform for coaches, a health monitoring system that won Best Capstone, an AI voice stock assistant, and a three-game football universe.

The focus is on apps that actually help people — assistive technology, health tools, speech assistance, and AI. VoiceBridge was built for family. Miracle League grew from years of volunteering. The range is the point.
